13:37.race_name: SIS Celebrates 40 Years Supporting Racing Handicap

runners.comment: Unexposed handicap newcomer and he's a possible improver on his return; has been gelded
runners.name: Berkshire Schmokin
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
runners.spotlight: 75,000euros yearling; finished in rear in his three qualifying runs (7f/1m) but he was gelded in September and is a possible improver now switched to a handicap on his return; needs close look for in-form yard.

runners.comment: Won over C&D on handicap debut before a close second at Kempton 11 days ago; key player
runners.name: Aneirins Sword
runners.spotlight: Proved easy in the market but opened his account when sharing the spoils on handicap debut over C&D last month; beaten favourite at Kempton 11 days ago but he was clear of the third and that was another good effort; still has scope for further progress and he's a key player back at this track.

runners.comment: Well-bred filly who is unexposed and needs a close look on her handicap debut
runners.name: Let Her Go
runners.owner: S & B Mulryan Mrs J Magnier Shanahan Hyde
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in novice/maiden events this winter, including when fourth of 14 at Southwell (7f) on her second start; should have more to offer now switched to handicapping and she's a half-sister to some smart winners at up to 1m1f; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Well held in all five starts and she needs a transformation after a break
runners.name: Whos On First
runners.spotlight: Well held in all five starts, latest when eighth of 13 on handicap debut at Kempton (1m, Polytrack; 25-1) in November; still early days but she needs a transformation after a break.

runners.comment: C&D winner who got back on track when runner-up at Wolverhampton on Tuesday; respected
runners.name: Thanh Nam
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D nursery in November and followed up at Wolverhampton (8.6f) two weeks later; didn't really fire in his next two runs, but he got back on track with a creditable second at Wolverhampton on Tuesday; that was his 12th start but he's been generally progressive on AW and he's in the mix.

runners.comment: Ran better than the bare facts at Wolverhampton on Tuesday and she's still unexposed
runners.name: Bergamo Gold
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in all four runs but she got hampered late on when fifth on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f) on Tuesday; wasn't far behind Thanh Nam in that race and she should have more to offer.

runners.comment: Well held in five runs for George Boughey and needs plenty of improvement on stable debut
runners.name: Bosh Soldier
runners.spotlight: Struggled in maiden/novice events last summer and she's been well held in two Wolverhampton handicaps this winter; left George Boughey since her last run (still in same ownership) and needs plenty of improvement.

14:07.race_name: SIS Delivers 500,000 Live Betting Events Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Minor promise on first 2 starts but much more on recent yard debut when 3rd to classy one
runners.name: Shafdar
runners.spotlight: Aga Khan cast-off; minor promise in Ireland and France on first two starts; sold for 36,000euros in November; bred to want further than 1m but he travelled strongly over the trip at Kempton on recent yard debut (20-1), before finishing powerfully into third of 12 to a classy type; smart prospect.

runners.comment: Big prices, never out of rear division in two 1m novice events, over C&D and at Southwell
runners.name: Machali
runners.spotlight: Big prices and never out of the rear division in two 1m novice events in December, over C&D and at Southwell; ordinary handicaps soon.

runners.comment: From family of high-class jumpers so has plenty to prove over 1m on debut
runners.name: Immediate Jewel
runners.spotlight: Gelded son of Postponed; second foal; dam unraced sister to 2m hurdle winner Llantara, from family of high-class chaser Observe and smart hurdler Minorettes Girl (dam of high-class staying chaser Shotgun Willy); plenty points to him needing the run and longer trips.

runners.comment: Dam bred smart winners, including at 1m; likely newcomer for leading yard; market crucial
runners.name: Picture Palace
runners.spotlight: By Pinatubo; tenth foal; half-brother to several smart winners including Blair House (1m-1m1f including UAE Group 1; 117) and First Conquest (1m-1m2f including UAE Group 3; 114); dam placed 1m1f in France (84); likely newcomer for leading yard; market crucial.

14:37.race_name: SIS Proud Partners Of Chelmsford Racecourse Handicap

runners.comment: Gave it a good go from the front at Southwell three days ago despite racing freely
runners.name: King David
runners.spotlight: Can be free as was again the case in this new headgear combination at Southwell three days ago (7f), though did give it a good go from the front; well drawn to adopt similar tactics here and very much considered.

runners.comment: Has only won a maiden in 18 runs but has threatened in handicaps; on a good mark
runners.name: Mandana
runners.spotlight: Has only won a maiden in 18 runs but has threatened in handicaps and she's on a perfectly good mark.

runners.comment: Four wins over 5f-6f on turf; 0-15 on the AW and 7f might not be his trip
runners.name: Silky Robin
runners.spotlight: Four wins over 5f-6f on turf last year when the application of blinkers worked well; however, he's 0-15 on the AW and 7f might not be his trip; absent since October.

runners.comment: No wins in 11 and hasn't been close to his best form on last three appearances
runners.name: Pickering Castle
runners.spotlight: No wins in 11 and hasn't been close to his best form on last three appearances; returning to 7f is a likely plus but others look safer.

runners.comment: Had plenty of chances (0-17) but he's been knocking on the door and returns to 7f
runners.name: Invincible Melody
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of chances (0-17) but he's been knocking on the door in five races after a break and 7f might suit better than the 6f over which he ran the last twice.

runners.comment: Off colour last time but was only a neck away in 7f handicaps prior to that
runners.name: Toussarok
runners.spotlight: Off colour last time but was only a neck away in 7f handicaps at Wolverhampton and Lingfield prior to that; respected.

runners.comment: Ran well in the returning cheekpieces at Kempton three days ago; his turn should come
runners.name: Sanditon
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 14 runs; thereabouts on a few occasions off this sort of mark and ran well in the returning cheekpieces at Kempton three days ago; his turn should come.

runners.comment: Still a maiden and comfortably held in four runs for this yard, latterly in the new hood
runners.name: Fort Augustus
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden and comfortably held in four runs for this yard, latterly in the new hood; confined to sprint trips thus far.

15:07.race_name: 49's Draws Now Four Times Daily Classified Stakes

runners.comment: 0-16 on AW and has struggled at biggish prices in two classified events this winter
runners.name: Celebrating Ethel
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner but she's 0-16 on AW and has struggled at biggish prices in two classified events (1m3f/1m4f) this winter; passed over.

runners.comment: Finished tailed off in all four starts and can only be watched on his comeback
runners.name: Keeper Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Massive prices and he's finished tailed off in his four starts, most recently on handicap debut at Southwell (1m3f) last February; still unexposed but he has a lot to prove on comeback for new yard.

runners.comment: Her last win was in 2023 and she needs a major revival on return for new yard
runners.name: Lisabetta
runners.spotlight: Her last win was in October 2023 and she struggled in her four runs in Ireland last year; returns after 111 days off and she needs a major revival for new yard; regular blinkers removed.

runners.comment: Overall record of 0-41 and well held in final two runs in Ireland; down the list
runners.name: Man Is King
runners.spotlight: Creditable third in a Dundalk handicap (10.6f, Polytrack) in December but he's been well held in both runs since; now drops back in trip for new yard but overall record stands at 0-41 and others are preferred; tongue-tie removed.

runners.comment: Won over C&D on his penultimate run and he's a big player if he can recapture that form
runners.name: Marinakis
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile and was down the field at Lingfield last time, but he justified support when landing a classified event over C&D (beat Prince Hector) on his penultimate run; could be a big factor if he can rediscover his spark and he's 2-2 at Chelmsford.

runners.comment: Polytrack specialist who has shown signs of a revival at Lingfield this year; dangerous
runners.name: Marions Boy
runners.spotlight: Lost his way in 2025 but he's shown some encouraging signs at Lingfield this year, including when third in a classified event (1m2f) last weekend; can miss the break but he's a Polytrack specialist who has possibilities if this sets up for his closing style.

runners.comment: Win and second at Lingfield (1m2f) in last two runs and he's a key player here
runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: Ended his losing run when scoring at Lingfield (1m2f) last month and he backed that up with a creditable second on his return visit last weekend; usually comes from off the pace and could be a major force again if he gets the breaks.

runners.comment: Went close over C&D on penultimate run but he was disappointing at Wolverhampton last time
runners.name: Prince Hector
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been at Wolverhampton (9.4f/1m4f) and latest was last March; went close behind Marinakis over C&D on his penultimate run but he's not easy to predict and was beaten 12l at Wolverhampton last time; comes with risk.

runners.comment: Capable at this level and contested a Class 2 last time from out of the weights
runners.name: Bint Al Daar
runners.spotlight: Four wins divided between AW and turf; inconsistent for this yard but has run some fair races in defeat and was 6lb out of the weights in a Class 2 last time at Lingfield (1m2f; first-time visor); this is more realistic.

runners.comment: Only 1-16 overall but arrives here in a fair run of form and unlikely to be far away
runners.name: Jodhpur Blue
runners.spotlight: 7f Tapeta winner; only 1-16 overall but arrives here in a fair run of form and unlikely to be far away.

runners.comment: Easy winner of a 1m maiden here before coming up well short back in a handicap
runners.name: Gennadius
runners.spotlight: Easy winner of a 1m maiden here before coming up well short back in a handicap; looks vulnerable off the same mark unless he improves for this longer trip.

runners.comment: Won twice on turf in the autumn; hasn't been running as well on the AW
runners.name: Annexation
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins in 1m2f handicap on turf last autumn; hasn't been running as well on the AW and others preferred.

runners.comment: Has made a good start for this yard and was a comfortable 2l winner at Lingfield; up 6lb
runners.name: Harlington
runners.spotlight: Has made a good start for this yard and was a comfortable 2l winner at Lingfield (1m2f) last time; the 6lb rise asks a question and they claimed 3lb last time, but clearly a strong contender.

runners.comment: Three-time winner at sprint trips but it was over 1m when a staying-on second last time
runners.name: My Awele
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing CII And Partners
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at sprint trips but it was over 1m when a staying-on second here last time; was no match for the winner but that effort offers hope for her staying this far.

16:07.race_name: SIS Broadcasts Chelmsford To 50 Countries Handicap

runners.comment: 0-13 on AW but acted well over 6f/7f here in 2025 and has dropped to a tempting mark
runners.name: Gundogan
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 6f turf novice in 2024 for one of his previous yards; 0-13 on AW but he ran well in all three attempts on this track last year and is well worth considering for current trainer off this lower mark back at 6f.

runners.comment: Maiden but had few chances; should find a 6f handicap on recent Kempton Polytrack form
runners.name: Respectable Jack
runners.spotlight: Maiden who hasn't had many chances in 6f handicaps but should find one on his recent Kempton Polytrack form, going close two starts ago before the front-running winner wasn't for catching on Wednesday (when first-time blinkers added, now retained); major contender.

runners.comment: Multiple Polytrack wins, the latest in December 2024, but below best since back from break
runners.name: Man On A Mission
runners.spotlight: Multiple sprint winner on Polytrack elsewhere, most recently in late 2024, but it's been a slog this winter and he made no serious inroads behind Respectable Jack at Kempton on Wednesday; cheekpieces refitted after two runs without; has work to do.

runners.comment: Not yet off the mark but running well in competitive 6f and 5f races of late; respected
runners.name: Forever Noah
runners.spotlight: Not yet off the mark but he's done well in competitive races over 6f, on Southwell Tapeta, and 5f (on this track) of late and it looks only a matter of time before he gets off the mark; respected.

runners.comment: On the premises over 6f at Wolverhampton in 2025 but often fails to beat a rival
runners.name: Jake Loves Laura
runners.spotlight: Has finished on the premises over 6f at Wolverhampton on two occasions for this yard but also failed to beat a rival four times, including back from a break in November; much more needed for first win.

runners.comment: Turf winner; best run for a while when 3rd in C&D classified latest; likely to need more
runners.name: Little Miss Magic
runners.spotlight: Sole win came on turf in 2024 but she acts on AW and ran her best race for a while when a persevering third in a C&D classified (raced wide; first-time visor, retained) last month; likely to need more here.

runners.comment: Maiden; often thereabouts over 5f but a big question mark about the return to 6f
runners.name: Marcus
runners.spotlight: Maiden; often thereabouts in 5f handicaps on turf and the AW but he has ground to make up on Forever Noah on their recent 5f run here and the return to 6f, for the first time since his debut, raises a big question.

16:37.race_name: Bet In Running On Chelmsford Races Handicap

runners.comment: Off the mark, under today's rider, at Lingfield last time (1m4f); stays 1m6f; big player
runners.name: Mio Amico
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Lingfield last month (1m4f) when ridden by 7lb claimer Kyle McHugh who is again on board; seems to stay this longer trip (creditable C&D fourth off this mark in October); major contender.

runners.comment: Sound efforts upped to 2m last four runs, including Wolverhampton win; solid chance
runners.name: Tuba
runners.spotlight: Sound efforts when stepped up to 2m on last four starts, winning at Wolverhampton in December and being placed twice since; solid chance.

runners.breeder: Al Shaqab Racing & S C E A Des Prairies
runners.comment: Two wins over 2m at Wolverhampton last year; creditable second latest; should go well
runners.name: Sneaky Blinder
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 2m at Wolverhampton last year; creditable second over same C&D last time and worth considering.

runners.breeder: R P Philips & Chapel Stud Ltd
runners.comment: Maiden; ran a couple of fair runs on turf last term, but not so good over 2m here latest
runners.name: Burano Murano
runners.spotlight: Maiden; ran creditably on a couple of occasions on turf last term, but not so good on stable debut over 2m here last time; bit to prove.

runners.comment: Last win March 2024; on a good mark and fair runs in a visor last twice; blinkers back on
runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.owner: R Miles V Miles T Stamp & Partner
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run (last win was over 2m at Newcastle in March 2024) but has become well handicapped and creditable runs in visor last twice; blinkers back on here.

runners.comment: Couple of fair runs on turf last year; on a long losing run; well beaten over jumps latest
runners.name: Corsican Caper
runners.spotlight: A couple of fair runs on turf last season, but losing run is mounting up; well beaten over hurdles last time; others preferred.

runners.comment: Maiden; beaten over 9l on Thursday having finished tailed off previous two starts
runners.name: Apache Eagle
runners.spotlight: Maiden; makes a quick reappearance having finished over 9l seventh of 11 at Southwell on Thursday (1m4f); tailed off over further on two previous outings.
